name: Advanced_AI_GPU_Benchmark_Dataset.csv
description: A dataset that records GPU performance metrics for advanced AI workloads across models and hardware configurations. It contains per-run measurements such as runtime, throughput, memory usage, and related accuracy/cost trade-offs to enable comparative evaluation of GPUs for training and inference. Intended for systems- and performance-focused benchmarking and analysis.
reputation: Niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face, mainly used by systems and performance researchers rather than broad NLP/ML communities.
